messages:
Sam: Heads up — seeing apiserver reconnects + controller-manager restarts in eu-central1 right after a cert rotate at ~23:07 UTC. GPU pools failing to attach.

sre-oncall-bot: Certificate rotation completed for control-plane certs in eu-central1 (id: cert-rot-2026-03-21-2307).

Priya: digging in. logs show etcd leader hops immediately after rotation. excerpt:
```
2026-03-21T23:07:12Z etcd: leader change 3 -> 1
2026-03-21T23:07:13Z apiserver: TLS handshake error: remote error: bad certificate
2026-03-21T23:07:14Z controller-manager: failed to renew lease: context deadline exceeded
```

Lee: controller-manager restart loop looks like the lease-renewer can't validate K8s apiserver certs — possibly TTL mismatch between CA and bundled certs. Not an OOM.

Carmen: GPUs are stuck in 'Attaching' state in eu-central1 because attach calls to cloud provider timeout when apiserver cycles. That blocks new capacity and wastes reserved slots.

Jonas: autoscaler is marking pods/nodes NotReady and kicking scale actions. We're seeing attach-fallback traffic to other regions which will spike cross-region egress and instance spend.

Alex: cost note — burst fallback to us-west already running. Rough extra spend visible so far: ~$4.2k in the last hour (estimate).

Sam: Proposed immediate actions:
- Priya: consider rolling back this cert rotation if safe
- Lee: increase controller-manager leaseRenewDeadline by +30s as a stopgap
- Jonas/Carmen: throttle cross-region fallback (pause autoscaler bursts)

Priya: starting rollback to previous cert bundle now (k8s-certs rollback cb-2026-03-20). If rollback fails we'll patch controller-manager args to extend leaseRenewDeadline and renewDeadline.

Priya: rollback applied (cb-rollback-189876). watching leader stability.

sre-oncall-bot: Rollback deployment recorded (change-id: cb-rollback-189876).

Lee: leader hops reduced, apiserver reconnects dropping off. controller-manager lease renewals are succeeding again.

Carmen: attach queue draining — 62/64 GPUs attached now, provisioning backlog clearing. Pausing further cross-region attach for eu-central1.

Alex: cost alert acknowledged and muted temporarily. We should run a quick postmortem and add gating to cert rotation pipeline to detect heavy attach windows. :eyes:

Sam: Agreed. I'll open a postmortem doc and tag infra/provisioning + platform-security for the cert rollout gating. Thanks all :thumbsup:
